title: Annotations Measure
description: Read the vector annotations placed on a volume and emit derived annotations back onto it. The Slicer Execution Model has no vector element, so both sides are <file> params declaring the annotations extension.

parameters.title: Input Volume
parameters.help: Volume the annotations were placed on (DICOM, NIfTI, NRRD, MHA, etc.)

parameters.title: Input Annotations
parameters.help: Rulers, rectangles and polygons placed on the input volume.

parameters.title: Margin
parameters.help: Margin in millimeters added around each derived annotation.

outputs.title: Output Annotations
outputs.help: Derived annotations to apply to the input volume.
